name: Nikko Co., Ltd.
summary: Nikko Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of asphalt mixing and concrete batching plants in Japan, China, and internationally. The company operates through Concrete Plant Related Business; Environment and Transportation Related Business; Crusher Related Business; and Manufacturing Contract Related Business segments. It offers asphalt mixing plants, including main units, aggregate supply units, combustion units, dust collectors, asphalt supply systems, and control systems; hot mix silo, filler silo, and dust mixers; and recycling, exhaust gas treatment, deodorization, and crushing systems.
